rationale: Recomputed the manifest recipe: all six source-file hashes match and their sorted path/NUL/hash digest equals source_sha256. All four reviewed tests' hashes match both committed and materialised files. Static inspection finds independent closed-form math/finite-difference oracles (not implementation-only comparisons); DDP spawns two ranks with rank-distinct inputs, all-gathers each rank's gradients and updated parameters, and checks both; entrypoint invokes trainer.main(), witnesses its hyperbolic quantizer/loss path and checks checkpoint/SID exports. No mock-only substitute. Static review cannot establish runtime success: verification_check must run all four suites with Stage2 interpreter and enforce nonzero tests/no skips/no failures.
